dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: A truly great adaptation must capture a film's core themes and seek to convey the inspiration that lies behind them...

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: The three attractions are certainly all up to par, and I trust that you'll be able to make them better still!

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: To enhance our film's aesthetic, I'd recommend a few classics for you to familiarize yourself with... Or, if you have the time, maybe we could watch them together?
